tasks.label: CentralDark Orquestra: PREPARAR
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'CentralDark-Orquestra'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $run=[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'run.id') -Value $run -Encoding ascii -NoNewline; Write-Host ('ORQUESTRA_RUN_ID=' + $run)

tasks.label: CentralDark Orquestra: 01 FILOSOFIA
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'CentralDark-Orquestra' $runFile=Join-Path $dir 'run.id' if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runFile)){ throw 'ORQUESTRA_NOT_PREPARED: execute CentralDark Orquestra: RUN 4 VOZES' } $run=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runFile -Raw).Trim() $out=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.filosofia.txt') $status=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.filosofia.status') $done=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.filosofia.done') Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out,$status,$done -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $rc=0 try {   $null=Get-Command hermes -ErrorAction Stop   $q='PAPEL=FILOSOFIA. Trabalhe READ-ONLY. Leia LEIA-ME-IA.md, AGENTS.md, docs/ARQUITETURA/JARVIS-ORQUESTRACAO-DELTA-E-ESCRITOR-UNICO.md e somente o contexto pertinente. Interprete a intencao vigente sem inventar autoridade, sem editar arquivos, sem commit, sem deploy. Entregue no maximo 1600 caracteres nos campos ROLE, INTENT, MEANING, RELEVANT_RULES, EVIDENCE, UNKNOWN, HANDOFF.'   & hermes chat -Q --max-turns 5 --source vscode-orq-filosofia -q $q 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { $_; $_ | Out-File -LiteralPath $out -Encoding utf8 -Append }   $rc=$LASTEXITCODE   if($rc -ne 0){ throw ('HERMES_EXIT=' + $rc) }   Set-Content -LiteralPath $status -Value 'PASS' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } catch {   if($rc -eq 0){ $rc=1 }   ('ROLE_FAIL: ' + $_.Exception.Message) | Tee-Object -FilePath $out -Append | Write-Host   Set-Content -LiteralPath $status -Value 'FAIL' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } finally {   Set-Content -LiteralPath $done -Value 'DONE' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } if($rc -ne 0){ exit $rc }

tasks.label: CentralDark Orquestra: 02 ENGENHARIA
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'CentralDark-Orquestra' $runFile=Join-Path $dir 'run.id' if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runFile)){ throw 'ORQUESTRA_NOT_PREPARED: execute CentralDark Orquestra: RUN 4 VOZES' } $run=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runFile -Raw).Trim() $out=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.engenharia.txt') $status=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.engenharia.status') $done=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.engenharia.done') Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out,$status,$done -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $rc=0 try {   $null=Get-Command hermes -ErrorAction Stop   $q='PAPEL=ENGENHARIA. Trabalhe READ-ONLY. Meça o repo atual e mapeie owner, capability, dependencias e executor real para a intencao vigente. Reuse before create. Nao edite arquivo, nao commit, nao deploy. Use ferramentas reais quando necessario e preserve exit codes. Entregue no maximo 1600 caracteres nos campos ROLE, CURRENT_HEAD, OWNER, EXISTING_ROUTE, DEPENDENCIES, EXECUTABLE_NEXT_DELTA, EVIDENCE, UNKNOWN, HANDOFF.'   & hermes chat -Q --max-turns 5 --source vscode-orq-engenharia -q $q 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { $_; $_ | Out-File -LiteralPath $out -Encoding utf8 -Append }   $rc=$LASTEXITCODE   if($rc -ne 0){ throw ('HERMES_EXIT=' + $rc) }   Set-Content -LiteralPath $status -Value 'PASS' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } catch {   if($rc -eq 0){ $rc=1 }   ('ROLE_FAIL: ' + $_.Exception.Message) | Tee-Object -FilePath $out -Append | Write-Host   Set-Content -LiteralPath $status -Value 'FAIL' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } finally {   Set-Content -LiteralPath $done -Value 'DONE' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } if($rc -ne 0){ exit $rc }

tasks.label: CentralDark Orquestra: 03 CONTRAPROVA
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'CentralDark-Orquestra' $runFile=Join-Path $dir 'run.id' if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runFile)){ throw 'ORQUESTRA_NOT_PREPARED: execute CentralDark Orquestra: RUN 4 VOZES' } $run=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runFile -Raw).Trim() $out=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.contraprova.txt') $status=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.contraprova.status') $done=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.contraprova.done') Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out,$status,$done -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $rc=0 try {   $null=Get-Command hermes -ErrorAction Stop   $q='PAPEL=CONTRAPROVA. Trabalhe READ-ONLY e de forma independente. Verifique git HEAD/status e as afirmacoes materiais que puder medir; quando pertinente rode apenas testes/validadores read-only existentes. Qualquer comando com returncode diferente de zero, timeout, SKIPPED ou evidencia ausente deve virar FAIL ou UNKNOWN, nunca PASS. Nao edite arquivo, nao commit, nao deploy. Entregue no maximo 1600 caracteres nos campos ROLE, CHECKS, RAW_EVIDENCE, FAIL, UNKNOWN, VERDICT, HANDOFF.'   & hermes chat -Q --max-turns 5 --source vscode-orq-contraprova -q $q 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { $_; $_ | Out-File -LiteralPath $out -Encoding utf8 -Append }   $rc=$LASTEXITCODE   if($rc -ne 0){ throw ('HERMES_EXIT=' + $rc) }   Set-Content -LiteralPath $status -Value 'PASS' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } catch {   if($rc -eq 0){ $rc=1 }   ('ROLE_FAIL: ' + $_.Exception.Message) | Tee-Object -FilePath $out -Append | Write-Host   Set-Content -LiteralPath $status -Value 'FAIL' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } finally {   Set-Content -LiteralPath $done -Value 'DONE' -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } if($rc -ne 0){ exit $rc }

tasks.label: CentralDark Orquestra: 04 SINTESE
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'CentralDark-Orquestra' $runFile=Join-Path $dir 'run.id' if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runFile)){ throw 'ORQUESTRA_NOT_PREPARED' } $run=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runFile -Raw).Trim() $roles=@('filosofia','engenharia','contraprova') $deadline=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(10) do {   $missing=@($roles | Where-Object { -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir ($run + '.' + $_ + '.done'))) })   if($missing.Count -eq 0){ break }   Write-Host ('SINTESE_AGUARDANDO=' + ($missing -join ','))   Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } while((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) if($missing.Count -ne 0){ Write-Error ('ORQUESTRA_TIMEOUT=' + ($missing -join ',')); exit 2 } $blocks=@() $inputFail=$false foreach($role in $roles){   $statusPath=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.' + $role + '.status')   $outPath=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.' + $role + '.txt')   $st=if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $statusPath){(Get-Content -LiteralPath $statusPath -Raw).Trim()}else{'UNKNOWN'}   if($st -ne 'PASS'){ $inputFail=$true }   $body=if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $outPath){Get-Content -LiteralPath $outPath -Raw}else{'NO_OUTPUT'}   if($body.Length -gt 5000){$body=$body.Substring($body.Length-5000)}   $blocks += ('--- ' + $role.ToUpper() + ' STATUS=' + $st + " ---`n" + $body) } $prompt="PAPEL=SINTESE. Voce nao e a autoridade humana; SEGREDO/CHEFE continua sendo a autoridade. Trabalhe READ-ONLY. Convirja as tres observacoes abaixo sem votar a verdade. Se qualquer entrada estiver FAIL/UNKNOWN ou as evidencias divergirem, STATUS deve ser UNKNOWN/RECONCILE, nunca PASS. Nao edite, nao commit, nao deploy. Entregue: INTENCAO, OWNER, CURRENT, DELTA_MINIMO, PROVA, STATUS, NEXT_CURSOR. Fontes:`n" + ($blocks -join "`n") $out=Join-Path $dir ($run + '.sintese.txt') & hermes chat -Q --max-turns 4 --source vscode-orq-sintese -q $prompt 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { $_; $_ | Out-File -LiteralPath $out -Encoding utf8 -Append } $rc=$LASTEXITCODE if($rc -ne 0){ exit $rc } if($inputFail){ Write-Error 'ORQUESTRA_INPUT_FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN'; exit 2 }
